features: Analog Turbo HD (HD-TVI) over coax/BNC — NOT an IP camera
ColorVu 3.0 with HikAI-ISP, 24/7 full-color imaging, F1.0 aperture
Smart-Hybrid light: IR up to 50m + white light up to 50m
active deterrence: flashing light alarm (red & blue) + audible alarm
built-in mic + built-in speaker, two-way audio over coax (echo cancellation, AI noise reduction, AGC)
release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2CE12DV0T-LXTS is a 2MP ColorVu 3.0 analog Turbo HD bullet with HikAI-ISP, IR and white light up to 50m, active strobe and audio alarm, and two-way audio over coax.
